# Metrology Central

> Metrology Central is an independent site on dimensional metrology, quality systems and AI/machine-vision inspection for manufacturing, with a focus on automotive and aerospace. It hosts the AI Inspection Atlas, a database of sourced real-world AI visual inspection deployments; a directory of US machine vision and metrology integrators; practical articles and curated industry news; and a free weekly newsletter on metrology, AI inspection and quality news, sent every Monday.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://metrologycentral.com/): Articles, news and highlights on metrology, quality and AI inspection.
- [AI Inspection Atlas](https://metrologycentral.com/atlas/): Sourced case database of real-world AI visual inspection deployments in automotive and aerospace.
- [Which tool fits my defect?](https://metrologycentral.com/atlas/fit/): Atlas tool for matching inspection defects to AI tools.
- [Integrators directory](https://metrologycentral.com/integrators/): US machine vision and metrology system integrators serving automotive and aerospace manufacturing.
- [Resources](https://metrologycentral.com/resources/): Recommended metrology books, measuring tools, training and guides.
- [Advertise & get listed](https://metrologycentral.com/advertise/): Sponsorships, integrator listings and case study submissions.
- [Newsletter](https://johns-newsletter-c0dcc2.beehiiv.com/subscribe): Subscribe to the free weekly newsletter, every Monday.
